description: Reads whether email from this site actually sends, whether it lands in the inbox rather than in spam, and how fast it goes out, with one honest verdict per point. A measurement sends real email, so it runs only when the stored result is missing or older than 24 hours; `run` asks for a fresh measurement, `force` overrides the storage. Read-only for the campaign, it changes nothing on it. Use it when the host says registrants did not get a mail, or before a launch. Not for the wording of a mail (that is wi_get_webinar_emails) and not to send a preview (that is wi_send_webinar_test_email). Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

force.description: true measures even when a recent result exists.

run.description: true measures again now instead of reading the stored result. Sends real email.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_check_mail_delivery
title: Check whether the webinar emails really arrive
